channel.title: Wire — Node.js
channel.description: Node.js from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Maintaining wait-on at Agent Speed
item.description: My first week as a wait-on maintainer, how coding agents shipped 27 PRs, six releases and a Rust engine behind the same API, and the guardrails that make that speed safe for a package downloaded 12 million times a week. (1 source: nodeweekly)

item.title: How to Compile JavaScript into a Single Executable
item.description: Turn a JavaScript program into one executable file, like Go and Rust do, with deno compile, bun build --compile and Node.js single executable apps. (1 source: nodeweekly)

item.title: DOCX 9.9: Generate Word .docx Files from JavaScript
item.description: Easily generate and modify .docx files with JS/TS with a nice declarative API. Works for Node and on the Browser. - Release 9.9.0 · dolanmiu/docx (1 source: nodeweekly)

item.title: H3 v2: The UnJS HTTP Framework is Rebuilt on Web Standards
item.description: 🎉 H3 v2 is now stable! It is a full rewrite on top of web standards, stays compatible with most v1 utilities, and is faster and smaller than v1. (1 source: nodeweekly)

item.title: Klattsch: Retro 1980s Vocal Synthesis
item.description: Fun fact: the klattsch app is built on a free, MIT-licensed speech synthesis engine. The klattsch npm package is the engine under the hood, meaning you can drop this voice directly into your own games... (1 source: nodeweekly)

item.title: Feedsmith 3.0: Fast Web Feed Parser and Generator
item.description: Fast, all‑in‑one JavaScript feed parser and generator for RSS, Atom, RDF, and JSON Feed, with support for popular namespaces and OPML files. (1 source: nodeweekly)
